name: Ultimate Custom Sounds Compilation
creator: ani
description:
This mod is a **compilation** of silly, goofy & shitposting sounds from 3 different mods, which I decided to update and merge into a single mod for QOL purposes.

The original custom sounds mods from which most of the sounds were taken are:

[Goofy ah Spells](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aWPVFOta_A4\&ab_channel=MagneticBean) by **MagneticBean**

[Shitpost Sounds Mod](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hnRJcf6yPBM\&ab_channel=Aze3a1) by **Aze3a1**

[Enhanced sound effects ](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=63e4doUzpig\&ab_channel=YiRok)by **Artista**



**NOTE:** An "EXTRA" version is also available which includes:

* Ambatukam Recall by Wiko
* Villager Shopkeeper by DrInfinito

This was done because, since they modify the same game files, you can't run the 3 mods seperately at the same time. Full credits of the mods go to the original creators.

You can download it at: [https://www.mediafire.com/file/9jxgbh0w3ua9yk0/Ultimate\_SFX\_Compilation\_EXTRA\_V1.2\_by\_Ani.fantome/file](https://www.mediafire.com/file/9jxgbh0w3ua9yk0/Ultimate_SFX_Compilation_EXTRA_V1.2_by_Ani.fantome/file)
